description: ITS4US HIRTA Health Connector Performance Evaluation Dataset is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Transit", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "ITS4US HIRTA Health Connector Performance Evaluation Dataset. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1404201". This dataset has trip level information for Health Connector rides taken from October 1, 2024 to June 30, 2026. Any information that could identify the rider has been stripped. Each row corresponds to one ride request. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Transit". It has 32 columns, among them DriverID, VehicleID, RideShared, DropoffTime, Booking, RequestedPickup. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation:. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
